title: Crash on launch after OS update to iOS 17.5
description: App crashes immediately on launch on iOS 17.5 due to deprecated Metal API call in renderer init.

title: Google sign-in fails on Android 14 (returns to title screen)
description: Tapping 'Sign in with Google' opens the account chooser, then the app returns to the title screen without signing in. Logs show GoogleSignInException code 10 (DEVELOPER_ERROR). Reproduces on Pixel 7, Samsung A54 on Android 14.

title: Leaderboard shows negative / wrapped scores above 2,147,483,647
description: Scores are stored as int32 on the leaderboard service; players exceeding ~2.1 billion points wrap to negative numbers. Reported by top-100 players.

title: Music does not resume after phone call (audio ducking)
description: After an incoming call ends, background music stays muted until app restart. Fixed by re-acquiring audio focus on resume.

title: Feature: colour-blind friendly palette option
description: Backlog feature request. Add a deuteranopia/protanopia palette toggle in Settings > Accessibility.

title: Daily reward claimable twice by changing device clock
description: Daily reward timer uses device local time. Server-side validation needed.

title: Tutorial tooltip overlaps pause button on small screens
description: On devices narrower than 360dp the level-1 tutorial tooltip covers the pause button.
